title: The Crook in the Lot
author: Thomas Boston
tradition_notes: Boston was a Scottish Presbyterian minister at Ettrick, associated with the Marrow controversy and the evangelical wing of the Church of Scotland. Known for his plain-English practical divinity and covenant theology.
